about: The best recorded Part 1 answers for drills (23 Nov 2026): one per question at most, two per topic, scored on giving a reason (the core Part 1 habit), answering first, an example, useful phrases marked, and a length near 12 seconds. Every line is already recorded (audio/speaking).

picks.question: How much time do you spend listening to music?

segs.t: Quite a lot, probably about two hours a day.
It helps me concentrate when I'm doing homework, and it makes the bus journey faster.
But my taste changes all the time. At the moment I mostly listen to Portuguese pop.

picks.question: What's the most interesting place you've travelled to?

segs.t: The Desertas Islands, near Madeira.
Nobody lives there, because it's a nature reserve, so you can only visit on special boat trips.
We saw dolphins on the way, and I was so excited that I nearly fell off the boat!
It's quite quiet, because I live in Machico, not Funchal.
It's right next to the airport, but after a while you stop noticing the planes.
When it's windy and the planes can't land, half the town goes out to watch!

picks.question: Is there a sport or hobby you enjoy?

segs.t: Yes, I play football every weekend with a local team.
It's the best way to relax, and I've made some of my best friends there.
Last month we won our first game of the season, and our coach actually danced!

picks.question: Have you ever had a part-time job?

segs.t: Not a real job, but I sometimes babysit my neighbour's children.
I'm saving money for a new phone, so every euro helps.
Last week the youngest one drew all over my arm while I was helping his sister with her homework.

picks.question: Do you go on holiday with your family?

segs.t: Yes, every August we fly to Lisbon to visit my cousins.
It's the only time the whole family is together, so it's noisy but amazing.
Last year fourteen of us stayed in one flat, and we had to take turns in the shower!
Not really, and it's because of the airport.
Our airport is famous for strong winds, so flights are cancelled all the time.
Last Christmas we were stuck in Lisbon for two days, and my little sister cried the whole time.

picks.question: Is there anything you really don't like doing?

segs.t: I really hate speaking in front of the class.
I know what I want to say, but when everyone looks at me, I forget everything.
marks: but when everyone looks at me

segs.t: Last term I had to present a project on volcanoes, and I forgot the word 'lava'!

picks.question: Who do you spend time with at the weekend?

segs.t: My friends, definitely. On Saturdays we meet at Forum Madeira and walk around for hours.
It sounds a bit silly, but it's the only time we can talk without our parents listening.
marks: It sounds a bit silly, but

segs.t: Last Saturday we spent three hours there and didn't buy anything!

picks.question: What's the most popular sport in your country?

segs.t: Football, of course. Cristiano Ronaldo is from Funchal!
So everyone here is a bit proud of him, even people who don't like football.
There's a statue of him near the seafront, and tourists wait in line to take selfies with it.

picks.question: Where's the best place to go with friends in your city?

segs.t: Definitely the Lido. It's a big outdoor pool right next to the sea.
It's cheap, it's close to the centre, and there's always someone from school there.
Last summer we went almost every day, and we stayed until they closed the gates.

picks.question: Is there something you do every week after school?

segs.t: Every Friday I go to the scouts near my school.
It sounds a bit old-fashioned, but that's where I made most of my friends.
marks: It sounds a bit old-fashioned, but

segs.t: Last month we camped at Fanal, and it was so foggy that we got lost for an hour.

picks.question: Do you have any good memories of school?

segs.t: Yes, our school trip to Porto Santo last spring.
It was the first time I'd been away without my parents, so I felt really grown-up.
marks: It was the first time I'd

segs.t: We talked all night, and the next day we all fell asleep on the beach!

picks.question: What are you going to do this weekend?

segs.t: This weekend I'm going to Cabo Girão with some friends.
We're taking a picnic, because the view is amazing and we deserve a break after our exams.
The only problem is that my friend Rita is scared of heights!
